content: We start this section by reviewing the GARCH(1,1) model, which is a strong benchmark used to evaluate our neural model. We then review the source datasets proposed in the literature that were trained independently and transfered to our volatility prediction model. Finally, we review the general architectures of sequence modelling and attention mechanisms.
